sections.Profile:
The "Caravelle" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on February 3, 1961, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Landmark, Travel, Original Theme, France
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Steve Kordek
